answer: Make each identity type a fresh 40-character phrase each epoch while the network records keystroke timing: dwell time and key gaps. A real person's cadence is stable yet noisy, like chisel marks on marble, no two strokes matching exactly. A sybil farm scripting a hundred puppets leaves a tundra of identical timing curves, and the detector collapses the whole cluster to one vote and burns its stake. Faking it means hiring a hundred humans to type, or building a hundred distinct timing models; each plume of fake keystrokes costs as much as a real typist, while an honest agent just types once.
